name: uganda-vat
description: Uganda VAT return work, tax year 2026-27: the 18% rate, registration threshold of UGX 300,000,000 from 1 July 2026, withholding VAT at 6% and its 2026 e-invoice exception, zero-rated supplies, blocked input tax, EFRIS, supplier patterns, bad debts and penalties. Use for Uganda questions from URA taxpayers, employers, advisers and foreign investors, including rates, thresholds, filing dates, the URA portal and worked computations. Figures for tax year 2026-27 come from Uganda Revenue Authority pages and the law, and items that could not be opened are named as unverified in the Sources section. Not reviewed by a licensed accountant.
